lines.text: Many learners say: I will come back after five minutes.
Better: I will come back in five minutes.
For a time from now, use in.
In! I will come back in five minutes.

data.wrong: I will come back after five minutes.
data.right: I will come back in five minutes.
data.why: For a time from now, use in.
data.memory: I will come back in five minutes.

native.tip: 今から先の「〜後」は in。after は過去から見た後のときに使います。
native.caption: “I will come back after five minutes.”と言っていませんか？😅 「5分後」を after にそのまま訳しがちです。“I will come back in five minutes.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“in”。“I will come back in five minutes.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: From now, use in five minutes.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I will come back after five minutes.” 😅 From now, use in, not after. The natural way is “I will come back in five minutes.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
